颖派科技是一家专门提供汽车车辆工程和汽车电子解决方案的工程咨询服务公司。公司前身成立于2011年，于2016年更名，注册资金2000万，现有员工80人，主要成员和合作伙伴都来自于知名国内外整车厂、欧美零部件一级供应商或设计咨询公司，拥有深厚的技术及管理经验。

    公司的主要业务集中于汽车电子电气开发、车辆工程、咨询服务。公司希望基于国外成熟的汽车设计理念和先进技术，给国内客户提供高性价比的服务。

    公司地址：上海市静安区汶水路451号0518室
    邮编：200072
    联系电话：+86 21 55225032

    INPLUS Technology is an engineering & consulting provider company focused on vehicle engineering and electronics solutions. INPLUS Technology was founded in 2011, and its’ chief members and partners come from famous OEMs, global tier 1 suppliers and engineering and consulting studios, which have plentiful technical and management experience.
    
    The main business are electrical & electronics solutions, vehicle engineering, and consulting service. We hope to provide high efficient service to customers based on advanced vehicle development theory and technology.
